newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Hanoi eyes buses as population booms.
newsitem.headline: Hanoi eyes buses as population booms.

text.p: Transport authorities in Vietnam's leafy, colonial capital are looking to a $52 million bus upgrade of the city's virtually non-existent public transport system as the answer to a population explosion.

The official Vietnam News Agency (VNA) said on Thursday that Hanoi's population of around 2.4 million was expected to nearly double over the next twenty years, forcing planners to seek transport solutions.
At present around 60 percent of city traffic is motorbikes, 30 percent bicycles and just 1.8 percent the traditional "cyclo", or three-wheeled pedal powered taxi.
VNA said planners were hoping to buy some 1,400 buses between now and 2000 and increase the current 13 bus routes to 66.
